params.name: status
params.description: Filter instances by their current status.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return per page.

items.docs: Returns a list of all GPU compute instances associated with the authenticated user's account, including their current status, GPU type, and connection details.

Provisions a new GPU compute instance with the specified GPU type, region, template, and configuration. The instance will be created and started, with SSH access details returned once the instance is running.

items.docs: Returns details about a specific GPU compute instance including its current status, GPU configuration, connection details, and usage metrics.

items.docs: Permanently terminates a GPU compute instance and releases all associated resources. This action cannot be undone. Any data stored on the instance's ephemeral storage will be lost.

params.name: instance_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the compute instance.

items.docs: Starts a previously stopped GPU compute instance. The instance will resume with its previous configuration and any persistent storage will be reattached.

params.name: instance_id
params.description: The unique identifier of the compute instance.

items.docs: Stops a running GPU compute instance. The instance retains its configuration and persistent storage but releases GPU resources. Billing for GPU compute stops while the instance is stopped.
